# Store screenshots

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/capture from scripts/capture/assets.json. Do not edit; run `pnpm capture`. -->

Every page of the store, captured by `pnpm capture` with Playwright's Chromium at 390 px (phone) and 1440 px (desktop) wide, light and dark, at twice the pixel density. Each image is the part above the fold; select it to open the full page. Motion is frozen for the stills and licence keys, emails and tokens are masked before a page is captured.

The test site is https://reelforge-dev.buildbase.app (BuildBase development environment, Stripe test mode); it runs the same build as production. Captured 2026-11-22.

**Empty states at capture time.** These pages are captured as they are and will be captured again (`pnpm capture --only pages --upload`) once their content is served:

- `/blog`: no posts shown (blog content needs the content-reader key, #93)
- `/changelog`: no entries shown (needs the content-reader key, #93)
- `/docs`: docs content not loaded (no content-reader key on the Worker, #93)
- `/docs/install/docker`: answered 404: doc page not served yet (#93)
- `/docs/mcp/tools`: answered 404: doc page not served yet (#93)
- `/docs/start/quick-start`: answered 404: doc page not served yet (#93)
- `/gallery`: no reels yet: the gallery fills once its reels are served from R2 (#89)

## Signed in on the test site

Two flows, each with a fresh `+test` account: claiming the free Personal licence, and buying the Studio tier of the Commercial licence with Stripe's test card 4242 4242 4242 4242. Both are also recorded as [walkthrough videos](/docs/screenshots/walkthroughs). Emails, passwords and licence keys are masked.
